title: Research and level proposals
current: /yoke models step 1 runs yoke update --check, which reports the installed CLI, the active server engine and the channel latest with behind cli|server|cli and server|none and a destination-specific next step: local updates CLI and server together with yoke update, a self-hosted server moves with its CLI through yoke self-host upgrade on the machine that hosts it (otherwise its admin upgrades it), hosted servers update with each hosted release; the update brings Yoke's newer catalog and levels. Step 2 reads yoke models revisions and yoke settings get levels and, where either shows shipped_defaults_differ, offers yoke models follow-shipped and yoke settings unset levels. An override researches official sources, validates, diffs and publishes an operator revision that stops following Yoke updates. yoke models level-proposal prints each level as model min_effort rows, lists placeable unplaced models separately from unplaceable ones that publish no efforts, and names reset as the apply command when the proposal equals the shipped defaults; any other approved document is stored with set, which stops following future shipped defaults.
